answer: The help center doesn't name any specific lenders that are outside the e-payoff network, so I can't give you that list; please contact a store for it. It only says that any lender not in the network requires the customer to bring a payoff letter or sign form NW-LPA-1 so we can request one. For reference, the network lenders are Bayline Credit Union, Northwind Auto Finance, Meridian Auto Loans, Pinewood Federal Credit Union, Lakeshore Bank, and Granite Bank, which joined on March 15, 2026. Customers with any of these lenders don't need a payoff letter.
